analysis.reasonEn: The stock has fallen for three consecutive sessions since the last buy signal. RSI is attempting to rebound after entering oversold territory. MACD histogram shows improvement, with no bearish crossover signal yet. Volume is subdued at 0.70 times the 5-day average. A potential Higher Low pattern is forming with the 5-day low at $278.69 compared to the 20-day low of $266.36. Current price is at 60.9% of the 52-week range.
